remaining_blockers.description: Requires full integration with live provider status-drift scrapers and scheduling clocks before we can run in automated production loops.
Production database connection setup must be validated with non-destructive dry-runs on real databases under safe transaction controls.
Payload-level duplication compliance requires consumers to filter using 'fact_scopes' or 'duplicated_for_schema_team_id_constraint' to avoid metrics corruption.
Downstream betting modules must be fully isolated from raw fact tables to prevent feedback loops.
Ambiguity resolution and team alias updates need an interactive or high-level admin approval tool for conflict cases.
Production DB must be verified to have identical schema version 20 to prevent schema drift errors.
Requires automated regression tests to verify that writing observations does not mutate, corrupt, or lock production transaction pools.
